scope: Synthetic world 42, four home styles × seeds 999/1001, original away style. No production save advanced. Baseline reports reused from the prior 0.28 matrix with identical inputs; club label does not enter football calculations.

replayFlow.definition: 团队球权区间可能包含短暂松球记忆；个人控制区间按真实控制者记录，结束原因为出球、射门、脱控或被夺球；球人/防守者距离按5Hz回放最近帧估算。传球方向按出球点与目标点；防线间距为防守方DEF与MID组平均纵向差。均为诊断指标，不等同官方统计定义。

validation: Unchanged repository mapping requires npm run check, Node22/24 CI, real-match/checkpoint/HTTP tests, controlled business season and one complete physical season; authoritative final execution status is the PR and work/validation/result.json or CI artifacts.

physical.scope: EURO 2024 men; regulation 90-minute portions; goalkeepers excluded; positional starters >70min. Elite anchor, not lower-league percentiles.

technical.scope: England–USA, 2022-11-25, includes added time; illustrative single match, not a population range. FIFA and game pass/turnover definitions differ.

goals.scope: EURO 2024, 117 goals / 51 matches; includes extra-time goals. Context only, not a per-90 target.
